shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md package.json next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx && git status --short && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.next'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts && rg -n 'instant\\s*=\\s*false|force-dynamic|force-static|experimental_ppr|fetchCache|revalidate|use cache|unstable_noStore' app components next.config.ts; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files .next/server/app | head -35 && git diff -- tsconfig.json && cat next-env.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && rg -n 'instant|force-dynamic|force-static|experimental_ppr|fetchCache|revalidate' app components next.config.ts"
